//: Curated mapping: CMS ContractPlanID (plans table / wizard plan param) → payer FHIR network Organization ids. Payer InsurancePlan→network link data is coarse (PPO plans list every PPO network plus dental/vision/Rx), so the medical network is picked by hand. Discover candidates with: npm run sync:payer -- --payer=humana --discover=H3533-027-000-2026 (or a name query). Verified live 2026-06-11.

plans.note: Gold Plus HMO/SNP Downstate — regional network, fast sync (~25k roles)
Medicare PPO — NATIONAL network (~19k roles per big specialty); full sync is a 1–2h crawl. Run overnight or with --plan filters.
